about: frontier-shootout-2026-11: eleven models against Claude Opus 5.5 in Hermes, OpenClaw and Pi. not_rebuilt.reason: shootout-merge.ts wrote them from the 79 shard results directories on the run controller; verify uses them as this run's receipts. Those directories are in the private raw release raw-frontier-shootout-2026-11, listed in reproduce.md.

not_rebuilt.what: The usage digests (results/shards/*/digest.proxy-usage.ndjson) that the analysis reads for safety stops, OpenRouter-reported cost, the amendment 6 checks and the spend with no record
not_rebuilt.reason: scripts/frontier-harbor/usage-digest.ts wrote them from each shard's proxy-usage.ndjson (about 200 MB in all), which stays in the private raw release listed in reproduce.md. Per trial, a digest keeps its safety stop lines and its OpenRouter-reported cost, and for the 3 Hermes effort_mismatch trials every usage line.
